name: Rocket Sideswipe
storyline:
The world of football has changed.

Traditional players are gone, and the greatest stadiums on Earth now belong to machines. Cars have replaced athletes, rocket boosters have replaced running shoes, and every match has become a spectacular battle of speed, physics, and precision.

You are a new driver entering the Rocket Sideswipe league.

Nobody knows your name yet.

Your only objective is to prove that you belong among the best.

Your first matches take place in local arenas, where you learn to control your car, master your boost, perform aerial flips, and discover how to use momentum to strike the ball with incredible power.

But victories attract attention.

As you climb the rankings, the opponents become faster, smarter, and more aggressive. The AI drivers learn your techniques, anticipate your movements, and attempt increasingly dangerous aerial plays. Every match becomes a test of reaction speed and skill.

Then come the biggest challenges.

The rival Orange team is determined to stop your rise to the top. Their drivers dominate the arena, control the midfield, and defend their goal at all costs. To defeat them, you will have to master every part of your car.

Jump higher.

Boost harder.

Flip faster.

Shoot with precision.

The final matches become legendary battles, where a single touch of the ball can decide everything. When the clock reaches zero and the score is tied, there is no time limit anymore.

Sudden-death overtime begins.

The next goal wins.

After countless matches, spectacular saves, impossible aerial shots, and last-second victories, you finally reach the championship arena.

One final match stands between you and the title.

The stadium is full.

The lights turn on.

The engines roar.

The ball drops into the center of the field.

This is no longer just a game.

This is your chance to become a Rocket Sideswipe legend.

The countdown begins.

3...

2...

1...

GO!
summary:
Rocket Sideswipe is a fast-paced 2D arcade football game where cars replace players and every match is a battle of speed, precision, physics, and aerial control.

Choose your team and enter the arena to score as many goals as possible before time runs out. Drive across the field, jump into the air, use your boost, perform flips, and smash the ball toward the opponent's goal.

The game offers several ways to play. Face an AI opponent with four difficulty levels, from Easy to Pro, or challenge another player locally in two-player mode. You can also choose between 2-minute, 3-minute, and 5-minute matches.

The physics-based gameplay allows you to control your car both on the ground and in the air. Jump twice to perform powerful flips, rotate your car while airborne, boost through the arena, and use momentum to deliver powerful shots. The ball reacts dynamically to collisions with cars, walls, the ground, and goal structures, creating unpredictable and spectacular plays.

Boost pads are scattered throughout the arena and can refill part or all of your boost meter. Managing your boost is essential for chasing the ball, defending your goal, launching aerial attacks, and making last-second saves.

When regulation time expires with the scores tied, the match enters sudden-death overtime. The next goal wins.

With neon-styled arenas, energetic physics, local multiplayer, AI opponents, aerial mechanics, boost management, goal celebrations, particle effects, and dynamic sound effects, Rocket Sideswipe delivers a compact car-football experience focused on fast matches and spectacular plays.

Drive. Jump. Boost. Flip. Score.
